name: Bouncy
effects: When deflecting bullets (using the Omega variant of Move-By-Wire cyberware), the ricochets deal full damage instead of just half.

name: Hardened
effects: The first time during each scene the weapon would suffer the Damaged state, it ignores it instead.

name: Masterfully Crafted
effects: Adds +1 base damage, or +2 damage for a 2-handed weapon.

name: Light
effects: The first parry attempt with the weapon only costs 1 instead of 2 AP each round.

name: Transformable
effects:
The weapon can switch between its usual form and another melee or ranged weapon chosen upon acquiring this mod. Switching the forms requires 2 AP. The other form of the weapon can be modded separately, but both weapons lose a mod slot for "Transformable", and the costs need to be spent on both.
The two chosen forms needs to be sensible - the GM is the final arbiter.
Such weapons tend to look bizarre and complicated, and any attempts to repair or modify them suffer a -2 pool penalty.

name: Binding
effects: If you use the "Suppress / Distract" spending option against the target you just hit, it is twice as effective.

name: Self-Repairing
effects: After one hour, remove the "Damaged" quality from the weapon.

name: Balanced
effects: The weapon gains Handling (1). If it already has it, increase its Handling by +1 instead.

name: Protective Handle
effects: The weapon gains Defensive (1, Melee). If it already has it, this mod has no effect.

name: Magnetized Grip
effects: Drawing or picking up the weapon only costs 1 instead of 3 AP.

name: Serrated
effects: The weapon gains the Injuring (3) quality.

name: Retractable
effects:
The weapon gains Concealed (2) if it is one-handed, or Concealed (3) if it is two-handed. If the weapon already has the quality, reduce it by 1 (to Minimum of 1).
In its folded form, the weapon appears like a regular item, suitcase or similar. Unfolding the weapon into its weapon-ready form requires spending 2 AP (this is in addition to drawing it).

name: Molecular Edge
effects: The weapon gains "Penetrating (3)" (if it already has it, increase it by +2 instead).

name: System Shock Module
effects: Upon causing an injury roll, automatically cause a cyberware malfunction roll.

name: Bludgeoning
effects: Gain the "Knocking" trigger option. If it already has it, the target has +1 difficulty to resist it.
